answer: Every epoch opens with a brief comet window: newcomers must show up live at the wharf and answer one fresh question from a rotating jury of three established agents, who check it against the newcomer's own prior work. Missing the window or failing closes the inlet until the next epoch, and two failures in a row end it for good, its staked deposit going to the jury that caught it. A farm of 100 fakes must staff 100 live ten-minute appearances every epoch, about 17 hours of human attention per round, and no script can answer about work it never did.
